subject: Marketplace onboarding: security evidence for Acme Healthtech listing
messages:
From: Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@amazon.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: evidence request for Acme Healthtech listing

Hi Olga,

Thanks for moving this forward. AWS Marketplace legal and security asked us to pull together the evidence bundle so we can complete the listing review for Acme Healthtech. At a minimum they want:
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted ok)
- Pen test attestation or executive summary
- Executed DPA or DPA draft for countersignature
- Encryption in transit+at-rest description and key management notes

Can you confirm what we can provide this week? If you prefer, we can accept redacted PDFs and a single manifest CSV that lists which artifacts map to the requirements. Also let me know if we need to route any unredacted docs to AWS under NDA.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Lewis
Marketplace Partner Ops — AWS Marketplace
anna.lewis@amazon.com

Attachment: Upload_Instructions_AWS_Marketplace.pdf (PDF)
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@amazon.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: evidence request for Acme Healthtech listing

Hi Anna — thanks for the checklist and the upload instructions. Looping in Laura (legal), Sergio (partnerships), and Kimberly (security compliance) to confirm what we can share.

Planned deliverables (we can get these uploaded to your link by EOD Fri):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf — we will redact tenant-specific identifiers and IP that map to CI/CD secrets.
- PenTest_Attestation_AcmeScope_2024.pdf — third-party pentest letter summarizing scope and no-critical findings. Full report available under NDA.
- DPA_Draft_for_Signature.docx — our standard DPA with platform-specific data flow appendix.
- Short security summary (1 page) describing encryption, KMS integration, SSO support (SAML/OIDC), logging retention, and access controls.
- Manifest CSV mapping artifacts to the AWS checklist fields.

Questions / requests for AWS:
1) Is redacted SOC2 acceptable for initial review or does AWS need an unredacted copy to be delivered under their legal NDA?
2) Please confirm the preferred filename pattern for the manifest CSV — we can name it REDWOOD_AWS_MANIFEST_Acme_20260618.csv.

Next steps for us internally: Laura, can you review the redaction guidance I propose below and sign off on the DPA changes? Kimberly / Security: please confirm the 1-page summary and the pen-test attestation language is sufficient. Sergio: will you confirm any partner-specific ask from Acme that needs to be surfaced?

Olga Petrov
Head of Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments (to follow): Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf (PDF), PenTest_Attestation_AcmeScope_2024.pdf (PDF), DPA_Draft_for_Signature.docx (DOCX)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 20:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: evidence request for Acme Healthtech listing

Thanks Olga — quick notes from legal:
- SOC 2: redacted PDF is acceptable for the marketplace intake in most cases. We should redact customer-identifying data and any internal IP (examples: raw model training data references, customer names, internal secrets). Keep the control narratives intact (that is what the reviewers need).
- Unredacted access: we can provide the full SOC 2 package to AWS legal under their NDA. If they request that route, let me know and I'll prepare a secure share via Huddle/Box and request a specific legal contact at AWS.
- DPA: I reviewed the draft. Two small changes: add a 60-day incident notification clause and clarify subprocessors appendix. I'll mark the doc and return a track-changes version by morning. Recommend we send DPA via DocuSign once redlines are accepted.

Kimberly: please confirm the pen-test attestation language is consistent with our 2024 engagement (I recall an explicit note about scope excluding customer-managed integrations). If it's different we should call it out in the manifest.

Laura Bennett
Deputy General Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

On Thu, 18 Jun 2026 at 16:03, olga.petrov@redwood.com wrote:
> Planned deliverables (we can get these uploaded to your link by EOD Fri):
> - Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf — we will redact tenant-specific identifiers and IP that map to CI/CD secrets.
> - PenTest_Attestation_AcmeScope_2024.pdf — third-party pentest letter summarizing scope and no-critical findings. Full report available under NDA.
> - DPA_Draft_for_Signature.docx — our standard DPA with platform-specific data flow appendix.
> - Short security summary (1 page) describing encryption, KMS integration, SSO support (SAML/OIDC), logging retention, and access controls.
> - Manifest CSV mapping artifacts to the AWS checklist fields.
From: Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@amazon.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: security evidence for Acme Healthtech listing

Hi all — great, that plan works. A few clarifications from AWS Marketplace intake team: 
- Redacted SOC2 is fine for the intake. If the intake flags anything, we will open an NDA route for unredacted review.
- For the manifest CSV, please use the pattern you proposed: REDWOOD_AWS_MANIFEST_Acme_20260618.csv. Include columns: filename, artifact_type, control_mapping, redacted (yes/no), notes.
- Upload path: https://marketplace.amazon.com/uploads/AcmeHealthtech/artifacts/12345 (I attached a short upload guide).
- Docusign: once DPA is final, we will accept DocuSign envelope; our legal prefers executed DPAs prior to public listing.

I'll stand by for the upload. If you hit any size-related issues or need a secure transfer method for unredacted reports, reply and I'll escalate to marketplace-ops.

Thanks,
Anna

Attachment: Upload_Instructions_AWS_Marketplace.pdf (PDF)
